title: Context Router configuration
description: Configuration for the Graphify-backed Context Router hook (.context-router.json at the repo root). Every field is optional; unset fields fall back to the built-in defaults in src/config.ts.

graphifyCommand.description: Graphify executable name or absolute path.

graphPath.description: Repo-relative path to graph.json (used for cache fingerprinting).

queryTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for a single graphify query.

codingTriggers.description: Slash-commands that mark a prompt as a coding task, e.g. "/implement".

detectNonSlashTasks.description: Also route plain-prose prompts that match codingKeywordPatterns.

codingKeywordPatterns.description: Case-insensitive regexes marking non-slash coding intent.

ignoreIntentPatterns.description: Case-insensitive regexes for prose to ignore (greetings, doc questions, "explain …").

fullRepoOverridePatterns.description: Regexes that make the router stand down so the model may use the whole repo.

maxContextBytes.description: Hard byte ceiling on surfaced read-files (source + doc + adr).

showBlockInContext.description: Prepend the human [Context Router] summary to the injected context.

searchGlobs.description: Directories/files the fallbacks are scoped to (never the whole repo).
